[[File:Edimmu icon.png|left]]
'''Elite Edimmu''' are level 90 [[Slayer]] creatures found in the [[Edimmu resource dungeon]] in [[Prifddinas]]. They can only be fought while on a [[slayer assignment]] (unless using [[Slayer Wildcard]]s), and will randomly spawn while fighting [[Edimmu|normal edimmu]]. In addition, it can only be attacked by the player it is after, and nobody else, for three minutes. Edimmu are assigned by [[Duradel]]/[[Lapalok]], [[Kuradal]], [[Morvran]] and [[Laniakea]]. They can also be killed under several cluster assignments, such as [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|undead]], [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|ghosts]], [[Zombies (Slayer assignment)|zombies]], and [[Creatures of Daemonheim]], effectively adding [[Jacquelyn]] and [[The Raptor]] as slayer masters that can assign edimmu. They attack with both magic and melee, and will heal for 25% of the damage they deal. Their ashes can be collected in an [[infernal urn]].

Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s and tier 3 [[luck]]. Elite edimmu are larger than normal edimmu (being a 2x2 monster compared to 1x1), deal more damage and attack a tick faster than them. Elite edimmu have a greater chance of dropping [[blood necklace shard]]s and are the only monsters to drop an [[Edimmu (item)|edimmu pet]].

As only elite edimmu can drop the edimmu pet, which is an item in the [[Slayer collection log]], players can use [[Jacquelyn]]'s short tasks to fight many elite edimmu under the ghosts and zombies cluster tasks. [[Slayer Introspection]] can be used to lower the assignment count to 15 and the [[Slayer master cape]] perk can be used alongside slayer points to skip tasks until a ghosts or zombies tasks is assigned. At least one elite monster is guaranteed to spawn in a slayer task, this effectively lets the player fight at least 1 elite edimmu every 15 edimmu kills. [[NPC Contact]] can be used to minimise travel and teleport time. 
Jacquelyn only has 12 different kinds of Slayer tasks, and players can block up to 8 of them, which greatly increases the chance of receiving the same tasks multiple times in a row, [[Slayer VIP ticket]]s giving an increased chance to get either of the cluster tasks.

Unlike their weaker brethren, elite edimmu do not have any weaknesses but still share the same affinities as them, making ranged the strongest, magic moderate, and melee the weakest against them.

During combat, other normal edimmu have a higher chance of aggroing to the player, which can often cause the player to become overwhelmed, especially at melee distance.
